item.vehiclecore.rotary_cannon.descripti: A cannon of swift discharge, running with gunpowder.
item.vehiclecore.bomb_bay.description: Drops TNT, doth not destroy blocks but deal heavy damage.
item.vehiclecore.telescope.description: A bulkier version of the spyglass.
item.vehiclecore.heavy_crossbow.descript: A heavy crossbow with a powerful punch, require arrows.
item.vehiclecore.airship.description: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.vehiclecore.cargo_airship.descripti: Slow and fuel-hungry, yet doth bear an entire storage.
item.vehiclecore.warship.description: A flying fortress, slow yet heavily armed.
item.vehiclecore.biplane.description: This trusty, rustic biplane will take thee anywhere fast and rather reliably. Make sure thy runway is long enough.
item.vehiclecore.gyrodyne.description: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.vehiclecore.quadrocopter.descriptio: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.vehiclecore.bamboo_hopper.descripti: A chonky aircraft with three seats and pontoons to land safely on water.
vehiclecore.gyrodyne_target_reached: Minimum rotor speed attained, ready for takeoff!
vehiclecore.invalid_dimension: This aircraft doth not work in this dimension.
vehiclecore.fuel.out: Thou hast run out of fuel!
vehiclecore.fat.out: Thou art too famished to fly!
option.vehiclecore.separateCamera: Employ a separate camera whilst in aircraft.
option.vehiclecore.useThirdPersonByDefau: Defaults to third person visage within aircraft.
option.vehiclecore.useCustomKeybindSyste: Employ multi-keybindings, may break certain mods.
option.vehiclecore.showHotbarEngineGauge: Render the engine gauge over the hotbar.
option.vehiclecore.crashDamage: Doth damage the player upon a crash.
option.vehiclecore.preventKillThroughCra: Shall not kill the player upon a crash.
option.vehiclecore.healthBarRow: Offset the health bar of vehicles.
option.vehiclecore.damagePerHealthPoint: Higher values make aircraft more durable.
option.vehiclecore.weaponsAreDestructive: Permit some weapons to demolish blocks.
option.vehiclecore.dropInventory: Cast down the inventory, instead of saving it within the aircraft item.
option.vehiclecore.dropUpgrades: Cast down the upgrades and customization, instead of saving it within the aircraft item.
option.vehiclecore.regenerateHealthEvery: Regenerates health automatically every given tick, simulating vanilla behaviour.
option.vehiclecore.requireShiftForRepair: Repair only when holding shift, else merely enter the vehicle.
vehiclecore.tooltip.no_target: Needs must be assembled upon the floor!
